notes.method: No new GPU runs. Offline analysis of current source and previously persisted measurements; model means, not medians, used for workload projections.
notes.formula: T = t_pixai + t_mobile + c*t_caformer + p*t_VLM; sequential stages with model reuse, excluding input fetch/disk/decode/exports, model start/stop and human review.
notes.caption_reuse: If a suitable per-character caption is already generated, extraction avoids a second VLM call; this is reuse of the same observation, not independent verification. Remaining conflicts may require another request.
notes.prototype: pixai_predict creates, loads and disposes PixAI for every image; cascade elapsed_ms starts after PixAI, excludes model loading/tagging and full end-to-end request time. Existing ONNX sessions are cached.
notes.production_scores: Current PixAI predict_batch does not keep all raw scores by default; snapshot_scores=True invokes a second full forward. Hair score capture should reuse original forward while preserving existing threshold semantics rather than invoke _full_scores again for every image. No implementation change made.
notes.gpu_serial: All underlying GPU measurements were serial. Proposed GPU batches should run PixAI, release it, anime Torii, release it, real Qwen. No cross-window automatic locking implemented.
limits: Projections are not measured end-to-end batch throughput of the proposed workflow.
120 original images are mixed synthetic repository contents, with sparse anime; threshold replay is not accuracy evaluation and does not include new visible-hair/people decisions.
Current early acceptance rule is preserved in replay; threshold>=70% only changes confidence requirement, not the complete proposed decision policy.
No head detection/hair segmentation runtime is included. Multiple head requests multiply VLM cost.
Single-GPU serial timing assumption; no concurrency speedup or larger-batch throughput claimed.
Mean Torii 2.764s is mixed set; 8 manually inspected anime cases average 3.644s, 5 group anime cases average 4.331s, so anime-heavy workloads can cost more.
VLM prompts/output lengths differ; this is configuration cost comparison, not equal-task model ranking.
RAM/continuous VRAM peaks not measured; request-after full GPU used snapshots: Torii6592MiB Qwen10329MiB, inclusive of desktop.
